category_title: Students with non-compliant behavior and difficulty accepting instructions or consequences
minimal_context: Garth is sitting at his desk with a textbook and worksheet to complete his independent academic work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Garth, please open your textbook and start working on the worksheet at your desk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes a loud buzzing noise with his mouth and stares at the wall) I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to get started on your independent work now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This is stupid and you can't make me do it! (Pushes the textbook aggressively across the desk)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: If you don't complete the assignment, there will be consequences.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't care! Shut up! (Rips the worksheet in half and throws it on the floor)

task.content: Independent work involving textbook and worksheet tasks or group activities

context.materials: Tape recorder, sheet of paper at his desk

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Noise-making or off-task statements in academic context; off task behavior during academic activities

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: No response or negative verbal or nonverbal response to adult initiation
Inappropriate verbal behavior toward staff and peers
